_comment: A brief that passes positioning_brief.py at exit 0. Note the audience is specific enough to exclude someone, three of four pillars carry proof that already exists, one pillar sits at 10% as the experimental slot, and there are three reasoned exclusions.
audience: heads of data at Series A-B SaaS companies who have three analysts and no analytics engineer, and whose CEO does not trust the dashboard

pillars.name: Trust debt in analytics
pillars.why_you: I have rebuilt this at three companies and measured it each time

pillars.name: dbt and modelling decisions
pillars.why_you: I maintain two open-source dbt packages
pillars.proof: public repos plus a conference talk

pillars.name: Hiring the first analytics engineer
pillars.why_you: I have written three of these job specs and run the loops
pillars.proof: two hires who are still in role two years later

pillars.name: Field notes and experiments
pillars.why_you: unproven; testing whether the audience wants this

exclusions: generic AI commentary - I have no edge there and neither does anyone posting it
hot takes on other companies' layoffs
vendor comparison posts that would compromise client confidentiality
